facts.fact: The national statistics strategy for 2022 to 2026 says statistical activity in Equatorial Guinea is governed by Law 3/2020 of 16 October 2020, which replaced Law 3/2001 of 17 May 2001 and was aligned with the African Charter on Statistics.
facts.system: Ley Núm. 3/2020 Reguladora de la Actividad Estadística
